rule: Every symbol is real Bitcoin material: inscriptions loaded from ordinals.com, or on-chain text records (Bitmap). Nothing is drawn by hand. Images were fetched from https://ordinals.com/content/<id> in a browser on 2026-11-01 and reduced to small tiles for bundling.

liveLoaded: Image-type collections (Bitcoin Frogs, Bitcoin Puppets, NodeMonkes, OMB, Taproot Wizards) also load further items from manifest.json live from https://ordinals.com/content/<id> (served with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *).
brandAssets: Xtrata mark: drawn on the cabinet door with the XLOGO vector code (the same trace as the bible SVG); the bible SVG is used as given on the test page
ParallaX Casino wordmark: the bible SVG, used as given, small, on the test page header only
logosNote: No project or token logos are used on this machine. Every symbol is an inscription (or a .bitmap text record); the communities whose art appears still need to agree before a public launch (communityPermissionNeeded).
